Description
The 1 oz Platinum British Britannia Coin marks eight years of the extremely popular Platinum Britannia one-ounce bullion coin.
1 oz British Platinum Britannia coin is manufactured by the Royal Mint which began producing Britannia coins in 1987 with the introduction of the Gold Britannia Coin which was followed by the release of the silver Britannia coin in 1997. Britannia has had a long association with British Coinage. It took 31 years for a platinum coin in the beautiful Britannia Series to be made available to investors since the range debuted in 1987.
Each of these Random Year 1 oz British Britannia Platinum coins contains one ounce of.9995 pure platinum, providing investors with an easy way to acquire precious metal while still owning a stunning coin.
Design of 1 Oz Platinum British Britannia Coin Random Year
The Obverse of each 1 oz British Platinum Britannia coin depicts an effigy of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, introduced in 2015 with a face value of 100 pounds and features an intricate background design.
The reverse of each coin features the effigy of the national female personification Britannia standing firm against a powerful gale. When Emperor Hadrian issued Roman Empire coins with an effigy of Britannia, Britannia first appeared on coins issued in Britain during the period of Roman rule. Since Roman times, it has been used to represent Britain’s strength and dignity on coins. The weight, fineness, and year of minting are also located on the reverse of each coin.
